title: On Normality Preserving Operations
summary: We study arithmetic operations and maps which preserve normality. Revisiting a recent argument of Dayan, Ganguly and Weiss, we give a streamlined, self-contained presentation of the probabilistic proof that the non-zero rationals are exactly the multiplicative normality preserving numbers in a fixed integer base. We also include the extension to all bases simultaneously, using the theorem of Hochman and Shmerkin.
